title: Crossing-optimal layout of K_{8,12}
headline: K_{8,12}: 360 crossings, equal to the proven minimum Z(8, 12) = 360
8 sources on the x-axis, 12 sinks on the y-axis, straight edges

outputs.edges: every source joined to every sink by a straight segment

conclusions.statement: This layout is crossing-optimal: 360 is the minimum number of jumpers for a single-layer K_{8,12}
weakest_support: Every drawing of K_{8,12} with continuous edges has at least Z(8, 12) crossings

support.statement: This straight-line drawing of K_{8,12} has exactly 360 crossings, at 360 distinct points (no three edges concurrent)
